summary: Turbo BASIC XL: provide, check and start the disk
description: Turbo BASIC XL runs on the Atari from a disk that you must own yourself; VintageCoder does not ship one. The project gets a copy of it (turbo/), building creates build/<name>.atr with the program as AUTORUN.BAS (vcc build), and vcc turbo run starts it in the emulator.

forms.summary: Check a disk: is it Turbo BASIC XL?

args.name: image
args.help: ATR image of the disk (90 KB, Atari DOS 2).

options.help: Output as JSON on standard output.

notes: The check only reads bytes (no emulator): file system, AUTORUN.SYS with the TURBO-BASIC XL signature, version, free sectors, directory and SHA-256 against the list of known images. Notes about leftovers (e.g. entries that were never closed) are not errors.

exit.0: looks like Turbo BASIC XL, no errors
exit.1: not recognized, file system errors or file not readable

forms.summary: Copy the user's disk into the project

args.name: image
args.help: ATR image of your own Turbo BASIC XL disk (only read).

args.name: project
args.help: Project folder (with .vcprj). Without it the current folder is used.

options.help: Reduce the copy to DOS.SYS, DUP.SYS and AUTORUN.SYS (more free space). Asks first; the original stays unchanged.
Use an image even if it does not look like Turbo BASIC XL or has errors (at your own risk).
Overwrite an existing copy of the same name.

notes: Turbo BASIC XL is not part of VintageCoder: you must own the disk yourself. The copy goes to turbo/ under the name of the original; the project file gets the section turbo and the .gitignore the line turbo/*.atr.

exit.1: image not usable, copy exists or cancelled

forms.summary: Reduce the copy in the project to the system files

args.name: project
args.help: Project folder (with .vcprj). Without it the current folder is used.

notes: Removes everything except DOS.SYS, DUP.SYS and AUTORUN.SYS in the project copy (about 480 instead of 103 sectors are then free; COMPILER.COM, RUNTIME.COM and the sample programs are gone). Your original stays unchanged.

exit.1: no disk in the project, cannot be reduced or cancelled

forms.summary: Build and start in the Atari emulator

args.name: project
args.help: Project folder (with .vcprj). Without it the current folder is used.

options.help: Folder of the hardware database (data); replaces VC_DATA and the automatic search.

examples.title: Start a Turbo BASIC XL project

notes: Builds the main program, writes it as AUTORUN.BAS onto a copy of the disk (build/<name>.atr) and boots it in the default Atari emulator (atari800; Altirra on Windows if chosen) in drive 1 without built-in BASIC. After the program ends (READY), Turbo BASIC XL waits for input. Altirra with a Turbo BASIC XL disk has not been checked yet.

exit.1: build error, disk missing or emulator not found
